```dafny
lemma AlwaysMorePrimes(k: int)
  ensures exists p :: k <= p && IsPrime(p)
{
  var j, s := 0, {};

    decreases k - j
  {
    var p := GetLargerPrime(s, j);
    if k <= p { return; }
    j, s := p, set x | 2 <= x <= p && IsPrime(x);
  }
}
```
